title: Decision151 AK producer private protocol — blocked draft
$comment: Early implementation selection only: no producer source or consumer concurrence yet. Scope reconciliation required for ak-db existing-only writable open. Startup request, baseline/effect and recovery schemas remain incomplete. Do not activate or infer capability. CLOSED must never be persisted or accepted on a new channel.

x-transport.public_input: One bounded startup request on stdin; no fd, exec, binary, environment or namespace overrides
x-transport.host_fd_0: Private AF_UNIX SOCK_STREAM socketpair endpoint; bidirectional length-framed protocol
x-transport.host_fd_1: Same open file description of permanent canonical AK flock file; opened unlocked by supervisor, deliberately inherited through stdio mapping
x-transport.host_fd_2: Bounded diagnostics only, never protocol or credentials
x-transport.cloexec: Host native bridge immediately marks 0 and 1 CLOEXEC; no tool/provider/UI inheritance; only supervisor may explicitly LOCK_UN after durable T1 validation
x-transport.framing: 4 byte unsigned big-endian byte length followed by strict UTF-8 JSON, no BOM; at most 1048576 payload bytes
x-transport.parsing: Duplicate keys, unknown fields/kinds/versions, floats, negative integers, depth > 16, strings > 65536 UTF-8 bytes and arrays > 4096 elements refuse
x-transport.digests: SHA256 lowercase hex over exact bounded canonical JSON: recursively lexicographic ASCII object keys, compact separators, no ASCII escaping, integers only; reject non-ASCII object keys. Digest fields never include themselves
x-transport.sidecar: Private immutable t1.json in the already reserved attempt/incarnation directory under the provisioned namespace; host fsyncs file and directory without namespace mutex; supervisor independently compares durable bytes to T1_PUBLISHED before explicit unlock
x-transport.closed: Private one-shot channel/phase/incarnation-bound message after explicit T2 unlock, not an on-disk receipt, not replayable after restart; dispatch also requires valid local outcome, deadline and post-unlock persistence
x-transport.failure: No automatic retry/unclaim; no EOF/timeout/finally unlock; surviving host retains OFD and denies dispatch on supervisor failure; all-holder death is not effect or claim retirement
